title: Batched parameter writes and allocation-free event sorting in the CLAP and VST3 adapters

installed_sdk.rationale: The adapters collect host parameter changes into StateStore::ParamWrite batches, and ParameterEventQueue gains a scratch-backed sort that keeps offset order without allocating. Host-visible parameter values and ordering are unchanged. This pending source receipt does not establish a released SDK artifact.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: The change is inside the format adapters' process path and adds no offline timeline command.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: The change adds no timeline MCP operation.

live_product_control.rationale: No remote control operation is added; parameter changes still arrive from the host.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No installed agent capability key is added or changed; the touched headers keep their reviewed dispositions.
